name: Otter.ai
description: Otter.ai is a general-purpose AI meeting transcription platform that achieved HIPAA compliance in July 2025 (Enterprise tier only). Pricing: Free (300 min/mo), Pro $16.99/mo monthly ($8.33 annual) with 1,200 min, Business $30/mo ($19.99 annual) with unlimited transcription, Enterprise custom ($17,622/year median). HIPAA compliance and BAA require Enterprise plan as add-on—not included on lower tiers. SOC 2 Type 2 certified. Key limitation: Not purpose-built for clinical documentation—no specialty templates, MSE formats, or EHR integration. Best for healthcare admin teams transcribing meetings and care coordination calls. For clinical documentation, purpose-built tools like Freed ($39-119/mo) or Mentalyc ($20-70/mo) are more appropriate.
short_description: Meeting transcription platform with HIPAA on Enterprise tier only. Free-$30/mo consumer tiers. Not clinical-specific. Best for admin/care coordination meetings.

faqs.q: Is Otter.ai HIPAA compliant for clinical use?
faqs.a: Only the Enterprise tier offers HIPAA compliance as an add-on. Free, Pro, and Business tiers are NOT HIPAA compliant and should NOT be used for patient data. Enterprise costs ~$17,622/year median.

faqs.q: How much does Otter.ai cost in 2026?
faqs.a: Otter.ai has four tiers: Free ($0, 300 min/mo), Pro ($16.99/mo or $8.33 annual, 1,200 min), Business ($30/mo or $19.99 annual, unlimited), Enterprise (custom, ~$17,622/year median). Only Enterprise includes HIPAA.

faqs.q: Can I use Otter.ai for therapy sessions?
faqs.a: Not recommended. Otter.ai lacks clinical templates, therapy-specific note formats (SOAP/DAP/BIRP), MSE documentation, and EHR integration. Use purpose-built tools like Mentalyc ($20-70/mo) or Upheal ($69/mo) for therapy.

faqs.q: What is Otter.ai best for in healthcare?
faqs.a: Otter.ai (Enterprise) is best for healthcare admin teams transcribing staff meetings, care coordination calls, and training sessions—not clinical patient encounters.

faqs.q: Otter.ai vs Freed: which is better for clinical documentation?
faqs.a: Freed ($39-119/mo) is purpose-built for clinical documentation with HIPAA compliance, specialty templates, EHR integration, and MSE formats. Otter.ai is a meeting transcription tool not designed for patient encounters. For clinical use, choose Freed.
